about: The columns' context scale and compaction points on whatever floor the server opens; sends nothing. Every column stands on one shared tokens-to-height scale (2026-11-09: one scale shared by all, the box drawn only on the focused column; linear to 250k, logarithmic above), so columns whose harness compacts at the same point (Codex: 90% of the model window; Claude Code: its auto-compact window less 33k; compact_points.py) have their points at the same height and a later point stands higher. The dotted box is drawn on the focused column only; it ends at that column's point, labelled in tokens ('367k'), with the universal ticks (100k, 200k, 500k, 1M) up to it; a label that would cover a name, a readout or a trace label is left out (the ghost's tip still says the point), and none overlaps another. The rim is amber from 80% of the point and burnt orange from 95%, box or not, and an unfocused hot column has its level ('97%') beside it. Checked at the fitted view, with a column focused, after a wheel zoom, and with a hot column when the floor has one: the server started with AGENT_IDE_TEST_PROVIDERS=codex,claude,fake adds the fake harness's running session at 97% of its 100k point; on a floor with no hot column those steps are skipped and logged.

actions.note: the git tree's first answer refits the camera (it moves only when a branch floor is on: the fit is the floor map, not the lanes, since 2026-11-22); the floor settles before anything is read
nothing focused: no column draws its box (2026-11-09); the same point is the same height on every column

actions.log: a hot column: its rim amber or burnt orange, its level beside it (only where the floor has one)

then.log: no column at 80% of its point on this floor: the hot steps are skipped

actions.log: a column with a point focused: its box alone is drawn, to its point, labelled; its readout says 'of <point> · N%'
the box's tip says the point and the rule
zoomed in by the wheel: the same heights for the same points, the same numbers
